_source: Jagatjit Agri Engineering Limited DRHP dated 25-Sep-2026 (SEBI filing 01-Oct-2026). Rs crore = Rs million / 10. Printed page numbers. FY26 is CONSOLIDATED (includes Saron Mechanical Works I and II, acquired with effect from 01-Apr-2025); FY25 and FY24 are STANDALONE (company only). The two bases are not comparable; the DRHP's proforma figures (FY25 revenue Rs 2,537.60 m, FY24 Rs 2,074.48 m) are the like-for-like series.

1.finding: 22:1 bonus (allotted after 27-May-2026) and 2-for-1 split are applied to all periods: EPS Rs 5.64 = Rs 313.90 m / 55,650,984 shares; NAV Rs 12.75 = Rs 709.29 m / 55,650,984 shares. Consistent across the Basis for Offer Price.

2.finding: FY26 operating cash flow Rs 26.85 m against PAT Rs 313.90 m (8.6%); FY26 working capital absorbed Rs 445.46 m of inventory and Rs 281.35 m of other assets. Cumulative FY24-26 CFO/PAT 69.7% (CFO Rs 281.93 m / PAT Rs 404.39 m) on a mixed standalone/consolidated series.

3.finding: Current tax Rs 130.30 m on FY26 PBT Rs 444.12 m (29.3%); cumulative FY24-26 current tax 26.1% of cumulative PBT. Profit is taxed in cash.

4.finding: Both plants stand on land leased from the promoters to 31-Mar-2055 (Cheema 19.47 acres; Dehlon 16.20 acres, Rs 0.08 m a month, +15% every 3 years), and the Rs 716.64 m expansion is on the Dehlon land. Company lent Rs 55.00 m to promoters in FY26 (balance at 31-Mar-26). Three patents assigned by promoter Dharam Singh on 21-Sep-2026 at below fair value (p. 56). Business bought from promoter proprietorships for Rs 324.57 m paid in shares at Rs 1,547 per Rs 10 share (p. 388).

5.finding: Fresh issue is amount-based (Rs 3,000 m), no fixed share count, so there is no objects price floor. Objects: Rs 1,100 m working capital, Rs 716.64 m capex, Rs 185 m debt repayment; the balance is general corporate purposes (cap 25% of gross proceeds) and offer expenses.

6.finding: No revaluation reserve shown in the restated balance sheets.

7.finding: Goodwill Rs 4.55 m restated (0.6% of tangible net worth Rs 704.74 m). The proforma balance sheet (p. 91) shows goodwill Rs 65.66 m at 31-Mar-25 and a capital reserve of Rs 32.98 m at 31-Mar-24; the restated note records goodwill of Rs 3.05 m + Rs 1.50 m. Purchase accounting differs between the two presentations.

8.finding: Top customer (Seth Agro Industries, not a disclosed related party) 25.21% of FY26 revenue; top-10 50.04%. Northern and Central states 93.99% of revenue. Supply side: top-10 suppliers 40.53% of FY26 raw material cost (76.68% in FY25 when promoter firms supplied); no definitive long-term agreements with suppliers or customers.

9.finding: Contingent liabilities Rs 71.70 m (GST demands Rs 22.67 m, other Rs 6.50 m, bank guarantees Rs 42.35 m) = 10.1% of net worth Rs 709.29 m.

R1.finding: CARO 2020 / Rule 11(g): accounting software had no audit-trail feature at database level until January 2026 (FY25 and FY26 reports). No change of statutory auditor (Anup Kumar Jain & Co) in the last three years.

R2.finding: Promoters and executive directors were in the past disqualified as directors because of a directorship in Jaggatjit Agro Private Limited, which had not filed financial statements or annual returns; the company also lists past delays in RoC filings with adjudication applications.

R5.finding: Offer is under Regulation 6(2) (does not meet 6(1)(a) and 6(1)(c)): at least 75% to QIBs, no more than 15% non-institutional and 10% retail, with refund if 75% cannot be allotted to QIBs. OFS of 3,100,000 shares by promoter Jagatjit Singh.

R6.finding: BRLM Keynote Financial Services: DRHP lists two issues (Amir Chand Jagdish Kumar (Exports), CSM Technologies); full track record is on the BRLM's website, not in the DRHP.

R7.finding: Capex orders: none placed for any of the Rs 716.64 m (100% unplaced); quotations valid for limited periods. Monitoring agency to be appointed before RHP.

rationale.g1: Proforma revenue Rs 2,074.48 m / 2,537.60 m / 4,139.70 m (FY24-26, pp. 90, 158): +22% then +63%. Units sold 19,111 in FY26 vs 12,234 proforma FY25 (p. 158). The issuer-commissioned CARE report puts implements at Rs 440 bn to Rs 649 bn, a 10.2% CAGR FY26-30 (p. 239), and farm equipment overall at 7.7% (p. 129). Bear assumes the FY26 step-up does not repeat; Bull assumes the 28% proforma CAGR (p. 248) fades.
rationale.m: EBITDA margin 9.74% / 14.51% / 13.46% proforma FY24, proforma FY25, FY26 (p. 158); restated standalone was 13.64% / 11.64%. FY26 gross margin 39.06% vs 20.98% restated FY25 is a result of consolidating the manufacturing proprietorships, not an operating gain. Bear 10.0%, Neutral 12.5%, Bull 14.0%.
rationale.nwc: Trade NWC (inventory + receivables - trade payables) 20.3% of FY26 revenue (Rs 838.52 m / Rs 4,139.70 m, p. 85); 21.4% on proforma FY25. Issuer projects inventory 130 days, receivables 45 days, payables 105 to 95 days (p. 128). Bear 24%, Neutral 21%, Bull 19%.
rationale.roic: Issuer RoCE 31.10% FY26 (p. 158) on a base that includes Rs 1,344.07 m of borrowings; terminal set well below it. Bear 12%, Neutral 18%, Bull 24%.

peers: Tillers and tractors; not implements. DRHP states no direct listed peer (p. 156)
